faqSection.title: Network Solutions
faqSection.subtitle: Answers to common questions regarding enterprise networking services.

items.question: What brands of network hardware do you configure?
items.answer: We work with top-tier hardware brands including Cisco, Ubiquiti UniFi, Sophos, Aruba, Ruckus, and TP-Link, depending on your company's performance needs and budget.

items.question: What is included in a network audit?
items.answer: A network audit evaluates physical cable integrity, switch configuration efficiency, RF wireless interference, packet loss metrics, routing security, and potential hardware bottlenecks.

items.question: Do you provide site-to-site connectivity for branch offices?
items.answer: Yes. We configure site-to-site VPNs, MPLS connections, and SD-WAN (Software-Defined WAN) architectures to securely connect remote offices, branches, and cloud hosting together.

items.question: How do you ensure WiFi coverage in large offices or warehouses?
items.answer: We perform active wireless site surveys using heatmapping software to measure radio frequency interference, wall attenuation, and device density, then place Access Points strategically to eliminate dead zones.

items.question: What is the difference between a NOC and SOC?
items.answer: A NOC (Network Operations Center) focuses on bandwidth, latency, uptime, and network availability. A SOC (Security Operations Center) focuses on analyzing security alerts, detecting malware, and containing cybersecurity attacks.

items.question: How do we get started with your networking services?
items.answer: Simply fill out our contact form or contact our team directly. We will schedule a consultation to map your office layouts, understand your device count, audit your current connectivity, and design a custom network solution.
